notes.title: Wilderness Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Hi, it has been a while since the last news but we are still working on Wilderness.

During this time we've fixed some bugs and the most important the save system which caused problems during the launch day, we also improved/fixed the basics and the bugs of the game.

- Fixed Save System for human
- Reduced building cost
- Bear AI attack won't trap you
- Reduced amount of human AI
- Metal Axe now showing in the radial menu

As well we started working on the multiplayer with dedicated servers, right now it works well and fluidly but we want to test more the multiplayer and give an update with good content and performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38633771/921816b401dc6a0ec86b4a0761153d851903f3c9.jpg[/img]

Also for an upcoming update we are adding a new map inspired in the African Savanna where we will be adding some new type of animals like lions, zebras…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38633771/9f70e4aff03b01777345aadf6b811d009b7762a6.png[/img]

We hope in the next weeks we can update the game with new features.
